main_text.p: סְחִיתָא, סְחִיתָא Chald. Stercus, Lutum, Soph. 1.17. Jesa. 5.25. Affine aliquo modo est Græc. σκάτον, σκάτ@.

סְחַף Ch. Depellere, impellere, propellere, expellere, Heb. דְּחַף ם & ר inter se permutatis. Partic. Plural. סְחִיפִין Impulsi, id est, festinantes, Esth. 8.14. Syris est, Evertere, subvertere, dejicere, detrahere, deturbare. Pahel ܣܚܦ Syr. Idem. Ithpehal Chal. אסתחף Impelli, Proverbior. 14.32. Syriac. Particip. plural. cum Aff. ܡܣܚܦܢ Dejicimur, 2. ad Corinth. 4.9.
ܣܚܦܐ Syr. Destructio, dejectio, subversio. 2. ad Cor.10.7.&13.10. 2. Tim.2.14.
מסחפא Chald. Hasta, Lancea, instrumentum bellicum, quo hostis prosternitur, & in terram dejicitur, 1.Sam.17.6.

סְחַר Circuire, circumdare. Pahel סְחַר Idem. Ithpehal אסתחר Circumire: Vertere, avertere, convertere se, redire, reverti: Versari, converfari cum aliquo: Sedere, assidere, accumbere. Aphel אסחַר Circuivit, circuire fecit, circumdedit, circumduxit: Reverti facere, avertere: Assidere, accumbere, discumbere: Accumbere facere, Cant.6.4.
סחור Chald. Circuitus, In circuitu, circumcirca, circumquaque, undiquaque. Geminari solet סחור סחור Circumcirca.
סְחָרְנִין Ch. Circuitus, in circuitibus, circum, circa, Respondet Hebraeo סְבִיבִים & סְבִיבוֹת.
סְחַרְנוּרִית Ch. Circuitus, locus circumjacens: Nonnunquam etiam adverb. exponi potest, Circum, Circa.

page.notes: Hebrew, Greek and Syriac words are rendered as closely as the scan allows; the vocalised Syriac and Hebrew forms in the Pahel/Ithpehal lines are doubtful and may contain errors.
